title: The Room of Harrow Glen
author: Xanthe Iversen
blurb: Quentin Thackeray, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
